rows.en: Of course. I act on my own convictions, nothing more.
The battle in this world is already approaching its final stage.
Altron, we want you to work with us too.
You of all people should know just how powerful the evil in this world is.
The righteous have to be strong, right?
Come with us, Altron!
...Very well. If our goals are the same, I'll team up with you for now.
But I have no intention of joining your ranks.
Yeah. Understood.
Thank you, Altron!
Listen, we're in the right. I'll never accept this world. Whatever awaits, I'll defeat the foes I must!
Obtained Altron Gundam's chip.
Completed the quest "Backing Up Altron".
You can report quests in the Quest Room at the base.
Are you an idiot!? We came all the way out here, so why isn't Wing Zero with us!!
THIS IS BAD, ALL OF YOU! ALTRON IS IN DANGER!
Pigmon, calm down!
From what Pigmon says, it seems Altron is being attacked by a huge number of Gundams.
I WAS INVESTIGATING THIS PLACE. THAT IS WHEN I FOUND ALTRON UNDER ATTACK.
Then those "Gundams" must be...
Yes. There's no doubt they're Virgos.
By the way, Pigmon, where did you see Altron?
THE PLACE I SAW ALTRON WAS THE ROOM WHERE VEDA IS.
ALTRON WAS IN A CERTAIN ROOM IN VEDA.
I see. Thank you for the information, Pigmon.
Everyone, please. Go and rescue Altron.
I AM COUNTING ON YOU!
Haah!
I don't care how many of you come!! Don't underestimate me!
Enemy reinforcements!
Damn it! One after another!! Don't underestimate Nataku!

notes.note: Quest021.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N+1 (checked: +111 Altron = 112, +112/+113 Sandrock = 113/114, +115 Heavyarms = 116 with 115 empty, +116 Deathscythe Hell = 117, +117 Wing Zero = 118, +118/+119 Altron = 119/120, +120 Wing Zero = 121, +121 Sandrock = 122, +124 Altron = 125, +130 Ankh = 131).
Deathscythe Hell (Duo) quoting Altron's (Wufei's) creed back at him.
Altron's parting line (+124). 'Ore-tachi wa tadashii' kept as 'We are in the right' (Wufei's justice theme).
Ankh (CHARA 36, +130), played when Wing Zero is not in the party (Pt_Chara_Check(9)); same script-fixed Ankh as the rest of this quest.

Rows 133-205 are NOT referenced by Quest021.bla (the script stops at +130; the pck holds the same script). This is an unused alternate version of the quest where Pigmon reports Altron in trouble. Speakers inferred: 133/136/140/141/144 Pigmon via Pan-Space Interpreter (katakana -> ALL CAPS, no contractions); 134/135/138/139/142/143 the polite quest giver, most likely Maganac (QuestMess pairs Pigmon with Maganac); 137 a casual party member.
140 and 141 are two drafts of the same Pigmon line (Veda ga aru heya / Veda no aru heya); 141 read as 'a certain room in Veda' (aru = a certain). Both unused.
Tanonda zo: Pigmon asking the heroes, so 'I AM COUNTING ON YOU!'.
145-154 (unused): Altron fighting alone; the '...' rows are the Virgos. 154 'Nataku' is Wufei's name for his Gundam, kept as in the source.

Unused leader-variant blocks with no script order: 156-170, 172-186, 190-204 (202-204 in quest_025). Voiced from wording: slots 5 and 11 polite (161/167, 177/183, 195/201), slot 7 rough Momotaros (179, 197). Polite 'daijoubu desu ka' kept the same English as the plain form.
Altron (unused scene), surprised the heroes showed up.

Treated as slot 0 of the 190-204 block (it lines up the polite/rough slots with the other blocks): Wing Zero's Heero-style version of 'Here they come'. Could instead be a Virgo line; 'Target acquired. Destroying.' reads fine either way.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers from Quest021.bla (N+1) for 112-131. Rows 133-201 unreferenced by the script (unused Pigmon-report version of the quest): speakers and leader-variant slots inferred from wording. No new names (Nataku kept as Wufei's Gundam name).
